title: Cooking Measurement Scaler
description: Scale any recipe up or down: enter servings and ingredients, get rescaled amounts with metric equivalents.
howto: Enter the original servings and how many servings you want.
Add each ingredient: amount, unit and name (up to 8).
Read the scaled amounts, each with a metric equivalent.

faqs.a: Mostly, but strong spices, salt, leavening and alcohol are best scaled to taste — start with 75% of the scaled amount and adjust.

faqs.q: What about cooking time and temperature?
faqs.a: Temperature stays the same. Time changes with pan size and thickness, not servings — check for doneness, not the clock.
To two decimals for readability. For cups and spoons, round to the nearest practical measure (¼, ⅓, ½) when cooking.
